subject: Sourcing path & invoice constraints — Redwood trial
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novigo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sourcing path & invoice constraints — Redwood trial

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and two asks so we can move the trial kickoff forward: 

1) Commercial path: You mentioned Novigo typically prefers a PO for platform spend, but for small pilots the team sometimes uses corporate card. Can you confirm whether Procurement will require a formal PO for the initial 3-month pilot (approx $22k USD)? If so, who is the procurement contact and do they need our W-9/Tax ID included on the PO?

2) Invoice requirements: To make sure billing ops can process our invoices, please confirm the following fields your AP team requires on an invoice: billing address, remit-to, VAT/tax ID (if applicable), purchase order number format, and whether you need itemized token-level usage or a subscription invoice. I attached an "Redwood_Invoice_Specs_v2.xlsx" with common permutations — feel free to mark anything that won't work.

Next steps I propose: procurement contact copied in a follow-up; Redwood prepares a PO-ready invoice template and the DocuSign engagement letter if procurement prefers PO + SOW. If card is OK, we can provision immediately after the payment method is confirmed.

Happy to hop on a short call with procurement if that helps. Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novigo.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novigo.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sourcing path & invoice constraints — Redwood trial

Thanks, Diego — good summary. Quick answers from Procurement: 

- Pilot under $25k typically goes via PO unless the business owner pays by card. For this pilot we'll need a PO.
- AP requires the vendor legal name, remit-to banking instructions (or our vendor portal enrollment), the vendor EIN/Tax ID, and an itemized invoice (line for subscription + line for overages).
- VAT not applicable for US entity, but if we engage EU operations later we will need VAT registration on the invoice.
- PO format: use numeric PO with prefix NOV-YYYY-#### (we'll supply the specific PO once approved).

I'm copying procurement@novigo.com (Maria Lopez) — Maria, Diego will share a PO-ready invoice and our standard SOW/engagement template to speed review. 

Elena

Elena Rossi
Head of Data & Platform, Novigo Health
elena@novigo.com | +1 (617) 444-1212
From: Maria Lopez <procurement@novigo.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@novigo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sourcing path & invoice constraints — Redwood trial

Hi Diego —

Thanks for looping me in. A few clarifications from AP/Procurement side: 

- Please provide a PDF invoice template we can place into our ERP (Coupa). We need separate lines for: Pilot subscription (monthly fee), Additional tokens (usage), and a one-time setup/implementation fee if applicable.
- Banking details: we prefer ACH payments; include bank routing + account or an enrollment form link. If you require wire, state fees net to vendor.
- Net terms: Novigo standard is Net 45 for new vendors; we can consider Net 30 for strategic pilots after credit review.
- Tax documentation: W-9 required for US vendors.

I reviewed the attached spreadsheet — items look fine, but please remove the token-level timestamps column (we don't need per-token granularity in the invoice).

Upload the invoice template and a blank SOW to the DocuSign envelope link when ready: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC12345

Maria Lopez
Procurement Manager, Novigo Health
procurement@novigo.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <procurement@novigo.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@novigo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sourcing path & invoice constraints — Redwood trial

Maria — thanks, that's exactly the level of detail we need. I've attached two files: Redwood_Invoice_Specs_v2.xlsx (updated to remove the token timestamp column) and Redwood_PO-playbook.pdf which shows an example PO-ready invoice and banking fields. A few notes: 

- We've set the default invoice to monthly bill in arrears with line items as requested. We can produce Net 30 or Net 45 invoices; please confirm which you'd prefer on the pilot so we set terms on the first invoice.
- For ACH enrollment, our finance team uses lockbox@redwood.com as the remit-to email + external bank details on page 2 of the PO-playbook. If you need our W-9 I'll drop it into the DocuSign envelope.
- Action: Maria — can you confirm the ERP vendor code we should reference on the invoice? If you want us to push the vendor enroll form to your portal, CC the vendor-ops contact and we'll submit.

If it's helpful, Marissa (CC'd) can run a quick billing ops alignment call with your AP team next week (15-20 min).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quick checklist I'll cover on the call: vendor enrollment steps, preferred invoice file format (PDF + CSV export), PO number placement, and bank remittance verification. I'll also confirm the Net term you'd like for the pilot and follow up with a finalized sample invoice.
